components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary editor action for fetching links, creating, and exporting.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #37af87; color: #f4f5f6; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #37af87; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Toolbar Button
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Undo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9.5 7.5 5 12l4.5 4.5M5.5 12H14a5 5 0 0 1 5 5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #61637a; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(75, 77, 99, 0.08); color: #25252a; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: rgba(75, 77, 99, 0.14); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #37af87; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Input
components.description: Compact URL input for creating card variants from supported links.
components.css: .ds-input-link { height: 40px; min-width: 240px; border: 1px solid #dfe0e6; border-radius: 8px; background: #f4f5f6; color: #25252a; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input-link::placeholder { color: #61637a; } .ds-input-link:hover { border-color: rgba(55, 175, 135, 0.55); } .ds-input-link:focus { outline: none; border-color: #37af87; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(55, 175, 135, 0.18); }

components.name: Editor Top Panel
components.description: Functional toolbar with file actions, canvas preset selection, and export.
components.css: .ds-top-panel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe0e6; background: #ffffff; padding: 11px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-file-button, .ds-preset-button { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #25252a; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-file-button:hover, .ds-preset-button:hover { background: rgba(75, 77, 99, 0.08); } .ds-panel-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-export-button { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #37af87; color: #f4f5f6; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-top-panel button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #37af87; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Control Panel Section
components.description: Right-panel grouping for link generation and background selection.
components.html: Link
components.css: .ds-control-section { width: 384px; border-left: 1px solid #dfe0e6; background: #ffffff; padding: 24px 20px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #4B4D63; } .ds-control-section h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #25252a; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-control-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-control-row input { min-width: 0; height: 40px; flex: 1; border: 1px solid #dfe0e6; border-radius: 8px; background: #f4f5f6; color: #25252a; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-control-row input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #37af87; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(55, 175, 135, 0.18); } .ds-control-row button { height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #37af87; color: #f4f5f6; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
Single Filter is a quiet editor for fast creator output. The interface should feel like a practical workbench: panels stay predictable, controls stay close to the task, and the canvas remains the most expressive object on screen.

The system is product-register by default. It values strong defaults, familiar controls, and fast export over decorative storytelling. Marketing pages may be more open, but the editor sets the visual standard: neutral surfaces, restrained hierarchy, and one confident accent.

It explicitly rejects generic SaaS gloss: vague productivity copy, oversized marketing sections, glassy decoration, gradient-heavy polish, and template-like AI aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Focused editor shell with dense but legible controls.
Neutral surfaces around a visually expressive canvas.
Single green accent for action, focus, and selection.
Familiar product affordances for inputs, panels, undo, redo, delete, resize, and export.
Light by default, with a dark token set available for focused work sessions.

rules.name: The Canvas Carries Color Rule
rules.body: The editor shell stays restrained so templates, backgrounds, and exported graphics can be expressive.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Green is for action, focus, selection, and confirmation. Do not introduce decorative accent colors in the editor chrome.

rules.name: The Panel Scale Rule
rules.body: Editor panels never use hero-sized type. Compact controls need compact hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter carries the product UI. Do not add display fonts to labels, buttons, toolbars, or canvas controls.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Panels, controls, and toolbars are flat at rest. Elevation belongs to overlays and the canvas object, not every container.

dos: Do keep the editor shell restrained so the exported graphic carries the visual punch.
Do use Workbench Green for primary actions, focus, and selected state.
Do keep controls familiar: buttons look like buttons, inputs look editable, icon buttons expose labels through aria-label and titles.
Do preserve platform aspect ratios and stable canvas dimensions.
Do provide visible focus, keyboard access, and reduced-motion respect for every interactive workflow.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS gloss: vague productivity copy, oversized marketing sections, glassy decoration, gradient-heavy polish, or template-like AI aesthetics.
Don't turn the editor into a pro design suite with dense manual configuration, floating inspectors, or hidden expert-only controls.
Don't make the product feel like a casual toy with gimmicky motion, novelty templates, or unserious export visuals.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or identical card grids as default patterns.
Don't let inactive states carry full-saturation accent color.
